premise: Low sunlight makes the whole plain twinkle: the moon dust is full of tiny beads of glass.
inspiration: The road paved with jewels of the folk tales, turned: the jewels are everywhere, and nobody needs to pick up a single one.
lesson: Treasure can be all around you, if you stop to look.
learning: Moon dust is full of tiny beads of glass, made long ago by the Moon's old volcanoes.

en-US.title: Glass in the Dust
en-US.text: [curious] Late in the long Moon day, the sunlight came skimming low across the plain. {canvas:glints 0.7 14s} {sfx:twinkle} And all at once, the ground began to twinkle. {all:face surprised} Here. There. Everywhere! {all:sparkle} Tiny sparkles, like sugar spilled across the dust. [excited] Was it treasure? {all:hop} Diamonds? [short pause] Not quite. {all:spin} It was glass: tiny beads of it, smaller than grains of sand, millions and millions. {all:pulse} {all:glow 0.4} Long, long ago, the Moon had volcanoes. They sent up drops of melted rock that cooled into little glass beads, {all:shake 0.3} and here they still lie, mixed into the dust. Nobody needed to dig. {all:wobble} Nobody needed to collect a single one. [warmly] {all:face happy} The whole plain was a treasure, just lying there, glittering for anyone who stopped to look. {all:hearts}

es-ES.title: Cristal en el polvo
es-ES.text: [curious] Al final del largo día lunar, la luz del sol llegaba rasante por la llanura. {canvas:glints 0.7 14s} {sfx:twinkle} Y de repente, el suelo empezó a centellear. {all:face surprised} Aquí. Allí. ¡Por todas partes! {all:sparkle} Chispitas diminutas, como azúcar derramado sobre el polvo. [excited] ¿Era un tesoro? {all:hop} ¿Diamantes? [short pause] No exactamente. {all:spin} Era cristal: bolitas diminutas, más pequeñas que granos de arena, millones y millones. {all:pulse} {all:glow 0.4} Hace muchísimo tiempo, la Luna tenía volcanes. Lanzaban gotas de roca fundida que se enfriaban en bolitas de cristal, {all:shake 0.3} y aquí siguen, mezcladas con el polvo. Nadie tenía que cavar. {all:wobble} Nadie tenía que recoger ni una. [warmly] {all:face happy} La llanura entera era un tesoro, ahí mismo, brillando para quien se parara a mirar. {all:hearts}

twinkle.prompt: a soft shimmer of many tiny glassy chimes, delicate and magical
